title: A Survey of Reasoning with Foundation Models: Concepts, Methodologies, and Outlook
best_for_zh: 需要先建立推理数据、方法与评测全景图的读者。
one_line: A 2025 survey that connects reasoning tasks to the models, data, methods, and benchmarks used to study them.
把推理任务、模型、方法与基准放进同一张图的 2025 综述。
why: It helps readers separate a reasoning claim from the particular prompt, data, model, and score behind that claim.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 survey from CUHK, HKU, HKUST, PKU, THU, and collaborators that gives a wide but structured entry point to reasoning data and evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning is often reported as one number, even though a model may be answering a language puzzle, reading an image, calling a tool, or following a long plan. Those settings use different inputs, intermediate information, and scoring rules. This 2025 survey asks how foundation-model reasoning should be described without mixing those cases together. It collects reasoning tasks, methods, and benchmarks rather than releasing a new training set. For a student building or judging reasoning data, the key question is simple: what evidence does one task actually require before a score can be called reasoning?
“推理能力”常被写成一个分数，但模型可能在做语言谜题、读图、调用工具，或执行长计划。这些情境的输入、中间信息和评分规则并不相同。这篇 2025 综述追问：怎样描述基础模型的推理，才不会把不同情形混在一起？它整理推理任务、方法和基准，而不发布新的训练集。对构建或评价推理数据的学生，核心问题很直接：一个任务究竟要求了什么证据，才能把分数称为推理能力？

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper builds a common map with four connected parts: foundation models, reasoning tasks, methods for eliciting or improving reasoning, and benchmarks. The useful move is to keep the task and its measurement beside the model claim. A chain of text may be helpful evidence in a math problem but irrelevant in a visual grounding task; an agent result may depend on tools and environment state. Readers should therefore compare papers by the full task contract, not by a shared label such as “strong reasoning.”
论文用四个相连部分建立共同地图：基础模型、推理任务、激发或提升推理的方法，以及基准。最有用的做法，是把任务和它的测量方式始终放在模型能力主张旁边。文本推理过程可能是数学题的重要证据，却未必适用于视觉定位任务；智能体结果还可能依赖工具和环境状态。因此，读者应按完整任务约定比较论文，而不是只看“推理很强”这一共同标签。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature synthesis, not a training recipe. The authors arrange prior work by task type and by methodological choices, then connect each family to the models and benchmarks used to study it. Use the same procedure when reading a cited paper: write down the input, required intermediate representation, available external tools, final output, and score. Then ask whether training data teaches those steps, whether inference adds search or prompting, and whether the evaluator checks only the final answer or also the process.
这是一篇文献综合，不是训练配方。作者按任务类型和方法选择整理已有工作，再把每一类同使用的模型与基准连接起来。阅读其中引用的论文时，也可采用同样步骤：记下输入、所需中间表示、可用外部工具、最终输出和评分方式；再问训练数据是否教会了这些步骤，推理时是否增加了搜索或提示，以及评测只检查最终答案还是也检查过程。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Its evidence is breadth and organization, not a new leaderboard. The official article describes coverage of seminal foundation models, reasoning tasks, methods, benchmarks, multimodal learning, agents, and alignment. That makes the survey a strong index for finding primary sources. It does not make scores from all cited papers directly comparable. When a result looks impressive, recover its original model, data, prompt, tool access, compute budget, and metric before using it as evidence for a new design.
它提供的证据是覆盖面和组织方式，而不是一张新的排行榜。官方文章说明其覆盖代表性基础模型、推理任务、方法、基准、多模态学习、智能体和对齐问题，因此适合作为寻找原始资料的索引。但它不会让所有引用论文的分数自动可比。看到亮眼结果时，应找回原模型、数据、提示、工具权限、计算预算和指标，再把它用作新设计的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier introductions often isolated one reasoning technique or one application. This survey places language, multimodal, agentic, and alignment-facing reasoning in a shared frame. Its novelty is the comparison lens, not a new model. It makes an important distinction visible: two systems may receive the same final-answer score while relying on different data, representations, and external support. That distinction matters when deciding whether a result should influence data construction, model training, or only a particular evaluation setup.
较早的介绍常只讨论一种推理技术或一种应用。这篇综述把语言、多模态、智能体和面向对齐的推理放进同一框架。它的新意在于比较视角，而不是新模型。它让一个关键区别变得清楚：两个系统可能得到相同的最终答案分数，却依赖不同的数据、表示和外部支持。这个区别决定某项结果该影响数据构建、模型训练，还是只适用于某个评测设置。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The scope is deliberately broad, so its categories cannot replace primary-study details. A benchmark label rarely tells you whether examples were generated, curated, translated, contaminated, tool-assisted, or graded by an exact verifier. Nor can the survey settle whether an explicit explanation faithfully reflects the model’s internal decision. Treat it as a map, then inspect the original data card, prompt format, sampling policy, and evaluation code before transferring a conclusion to another task.
它的范围刻意很广，因此分类不能替代原始研究的细节。一个基准名称通常不会告诉你样例是生成的、人工整理的、翻译的、可能泄漏的、带工具的，还是由精确验证器评分的。综述也不能判定一段显式解释是否真实反映模型的内部决策。应先把它当地图，再查看原始数据说明、提示格式、采样规则和评测代码，之后才把结论迁移到另一个任务。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Start here when a project says “we need reasoning data” but has not specified the target behavior. Use the task map to choose a narrow capability, then define what an example contains and how success will be checked. For instance, a geometry proof, a retrieval question, and a tool-use trajectory should not inherit one another’s labels or metrics. The paper also helps students turn a vague literature search into concrete columns: task, input, intermediate signal, feedback, benchmark, and unresolved failure.
当项目只说“需要推理数据”却没有指定目标行为时，可从这篇开始。先用任务地图选定狭窄能力，再定义一个样本包含什么、如何检查成功。例如，几何证明、检索问答和工具使用轨迹不该共用同一套标签或指标。论文还能帮助学生把模糊的文献搜索变成具体栏目：任务、输入、中间信号、反馈、基准和未解决的失败。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the task and benchmark portions before the outlook. Make a two-column note for each relevant family: “what behavior is required?” and “what evidence can establish it?” If those answers are missing, do not treat a capability name as a complete specification. Next read the method sections with one practical question: did the claimed gain come from better examples, changed training, more inference computation, or stronger external tools? This habit prevents a broad survey from becoming a list of interchangeable techniques.
建议先读任务和基准部分，再读展望。对每个相关类别做两栏笔记：“需要什么行为？”和“什么证据能证明它？”如果答案缺失，就不要把能力名称当成完整规格。接着带着一个实际问题读方法部分：效果提升来自更好的样例、改变的训练、更多推理计算，还是更强的外部工具？这个习惯能避免把一篇宽综述读成一串可互换技巧。
